name: Limodia

_published_faq.name: How do I add Limodia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Limodia to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.limodia.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Limodia MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Limodia scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Limodia MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Limodia provides these MCP tools: search_car_service_operators.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Limodia?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Limodia in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Limodia does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Limodia is developed by Limodia. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
